chunks: A number of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Khalid, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Abi Nasr, from Aban, from Yahya ibn Abi al-'Ala', from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
Al-Hasan and Al-Husayn (peace be upon them) used to wear their rings on their left hands.
ai.seo_question: Did the Imams wear their rings on the left or right hand?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi highlights the specific practice of Imam Hasan and Imam Husayn (peace be upon them) wearing their signet rings on the left hand, a detail preserved through a chain of prominent narrators including Aban ibn Taghlib. In Shia jurisprudence, this serves as a key evidence for the permissibility and recommended etiquette of wearing rings, distinguishing the customs of the Ahl al-Bayt while aligning with the broader prophetic tradition of using rings for sealing documents and personal identification.
